# Test m2 - escaped char and footnote
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', '''
import markdown

# Test 1: Escaped char in ID
md_text = r"# escaped\\_character"
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])
html = md.convert(md_text)
print("Test 1 - escaped char:")
print(f"  HTML: {html}")
assert 'id="escaped_character"' in html, f"Expected id='escaped_character', got: {html}"
print("  PASSED")

# Test 2: Footnote ref stripped
md_text2 = """# Header with footnote[^1]

Some text.

[^1]: This is the footnote text.
"""
md2 = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
html2 = md2.convert(md_text2)
print("\\nTest 2 - footnote:")
print(f"  TOC name: {repr(md2.toc_tokens[0]['name'])}")
assert md2.toc_tokens[0]["name"] == "Header with footnote", f"Expected 'Header with footnote', got: {md2.toc_tokens[0]['name']}"
print("  PASSED")
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
print("Return code:", result.returncode)
